reportFrequency.label: Report Frequency
reportFrequency.helpText: How often should the health report be generated?

reportHour.label: Report Time (UTC)
reportHour.helpText: Hour of day (0-23 UTC) when the report should be generated. Default is 12 (noon UTC).

showPosts.label: Show Post Count
showPosts.helpText: Include post submission count in the report.

showComments.label: Show Comment Count
showComments.helpText: Include comment submission count in the report.

showRemovals.label: Show Removal Count
showRemovals.helpText: Include content removal count in the report.

showApprovals.label: Show Approval Count
showApprovals.helpText: Include content approval count in the report.

showRuleViolations.label: Show Rule Violations
showRuleViolations.helpText: Include the top violated rules section in the report.

showTopOffenders.label: Show Repeat Offenders
showTopOffenders.helpText: Include the repeat offenders section in the report.

showModActivity.label: Show Mod Activity
showModActivity.helpText: Include the moderator activity section in the report.

showKarmaStats.label: Show Karma Stats
showKarmaStats.helpText: Include karma statistics (account age, link/comment karma) for repeat offenders.

showLeaderboard.label: Show Mod Leaderboard
showLeaderboard.helpText: Show ranked leaderboard of top moderators by action count with workload percentages.

showInactiveAlerts.label: Show Inactive Mod Alerts
showInactiveAlerts.helpText: Flag moderators who have been inactive beyond the threshold.

inactiveThresholdDays.label: Inactive Threshold (Days)
inactiveThresholdDays.helpText: Number of days without action before a moderator is flagged as inactive. Default: 5.
